content.comment_body: Hello everyone, has anyone developed a time clock program that can be modified directly through the [product_name] interface? I'm currently using [product_name] for pump and boiler sequencing, along with an external time clock. I'm considering transitioning to the [product_name] interface and wish to configure a 7-day schedule for multiple heating zones with customizable on/off times. Has anyone implemented something similar? I was planning to purchase a [product_name] interface to test if this setup is possible before committing. Any advice or suggestions would be greatly appreciated.
Yes, this is possible. You can utilize weekly timers in place of the external clock and adjust the activation and deactivation times directly via the [product_name] interface.

analysis.insight_summary: A user seeks to replace an external time clock with an integrated weekly schedule that can be programmed through the [product_name] interface, aiming to support multiple heating zones with flexible scheduling. The responses indicate that using weekly timers managed via the [product_name] interface is feasible and provides in-device editing, eliminating the need for additional hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to configure a multi-zone, 7-day schedule with adjustable on/off times, all managed through the [product_name] interface rather than depending on an external time clock.
